newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN JANUARY UNEMPLOYMENT RISES TO 13.4 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN JANUARY UNEMPLOYMENT RISES TO 13.4 PCT.

text.p: The number of people unemployed in Bulgaria rose to 512,992 or 13.4 percent of the workforce in January from 478,770 in December, the National Labour Exchange (NLE) said.
"The jobless rate increased due to a decline of seasonal
jobs in farming, tourism and construction sectors," a NLE
Hit by a severe economic crisis and preparing for the
introduction of a tough fixed exchange rate system, Bulgaria
has earmarked 64 loss-making state enterprises for closure.
Restructuring at some of those firms had left some 22,000
people jobless in the last quarter of 1996, NLE figures show.
